Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").ID)
    Case 1
        ws.Range("A1").ID = "first"
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").ID)
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A1").ID = "first"
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1:B2").ID)
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1:B2").ID = "both"
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").ID & "|" & ws.Range("B2").ID & "|" & ws.Range("A1:B2").ID)
    Case 4
        ws.Range("A1").ID = 5
        Tried = CStr(TypeName(ws.Range("A1").ID) & ":" & ws.Range("A1").ID)
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1").ID = "x"
        ws.Range("A1").ClearContents
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").ID)
    Case 6
        ws.Range("A1").ID = "x"
        ws.Range("A1").Clear
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").ID)
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1").ID = "x"
        ws.Range("A1").Copy ws.Range("C1")
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("C1").ID)
    Case 8
        ws.Range("A1").ID = "x"
        ws.Rows(1).Insert
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").ID & "|" & ws.Range("A2").ID)
    Case 9
        ws.Range("A1").ID = "x"
        ws.Range("A2").ID = "x"
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A2").ID)
    Case 10
        ws.Range("A1").ID = ""
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").ID)
    Case 11
        ws.Range("A1").ID = "a b"
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").ID)
    Case 12
        ws.Range("A1,C3").ID = "two"
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").ID & "|" & ws.Range("C3").ID)
    Case 13
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").AllowEdit)
    Case 14
        ws.Protect
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").AllowEdit)
    Case 15
        ws.Range("A1").Locked = False
        ws.Protect
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").AllowEdit)
    Case 16
        ws.Range("A1").Locked = False
        ws.Protect
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1:A2").AllowEdit)
    Case 17
        ws.Range("A1:A2").Locked = False
        ws.Protect
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1:A2").AllowEdit)
    Case 18
        ws.Protect UserInterfaceOnly:=True
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").AllowEdit)
    Case 19
        ws.Protect DrawingObjects:=True, Contents:=False
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").AllowEdit)
    Case 20
        ws.Protect
        ws.Unprotect
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").AllowEdit)
    Case 21
        ws.Range("A1").Locked = False
        ws.Protect
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1,C3").AllowEdit)
    Case 22
        ws.Range("A1,C3").Locked = False
        ws.Protect
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1,C3").AllowEdit)
    Case 23
        wb.Protect Structure:=True
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").AllowEdit)
    Case 24
        ws.Protect Password:="p"
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").AllowEdit)
    Case 25
        ws.Range("A1").Locked = Null
        ws.Protect
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").AllowEdit)
    Case 26
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(3, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 27
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", "x")
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", "y")
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(3, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 28
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array(1, 2)
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array(3, 4)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array(5, 6)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(3, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 29
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Year", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array(2020, 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array(2021, 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(3, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 30
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array(2020, 2021)
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array(1, 2)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array(3, 4)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(3, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 31
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 32
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(2, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 33
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(3, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 34
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(3, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 35
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("", "")
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(3, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 36
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Sub", "Unit")
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A4").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(4, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 37
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("name", "qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(2, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 38
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", 5)
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(3, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 39
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array(True, False)
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array(1, 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(2, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 40
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", #1/1/2020#)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", #1/2/2020#)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(3, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 41
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("=1+1", 1)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").Resize(2, 2).ListHeaderRows)
    Case 42
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A2").ListHeaderRows)
    Case 43
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").ListHeaderRows)
    Case 44
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1:A3").ListHeaderRows)
    Case 45
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("B1:B3").ListHeaderRows)
    Case 46
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A2:B3").ListHeaderRows)
    Case 47
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1:B3,D1:E3").ListHeaderRows)
    Case 48
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        ws.Range("A1:B1").Font.Bold = True
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1:B3").ListHeaderRows)
    Case 49
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", "x")
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", "y")
        ws.Range("A1:B1").Font.Bold = True
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1:B3").ListHeaderRows)
    Case 50
        ws.Range("A1").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("Name", "Qty")
        ws.Range("A2").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("a", 1)
        ws.Range("A3").Resize(1, 2).Value = Array("b", 2)
        ws.ListObjects.Add xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B3"), , xlYes
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1:B3").ListHeaderRows)
    Case 51
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1:B3").ListHeaderRows)
    Case 52
        Tried = CStr(ws.Range("A1").ListHeaderRows)
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
